description: FULL-VOLUME PARITY OVER 100% UNMODIFIED FIXTURE BYTES, WITH ZERO OVERRIDING ROWS. Where case01 fixes the frame with a single category-balance record, this case drives the entire shipped fixture set through the interest calculator in one pass and pins the aggregate. All five inputs are bare fixture references and not one row is inlined, narrowed, overridden or invented: TCATBALF is all 50 rows of app/data/ASCII/tcatbal.txt, ACCTFILE all 50 of acctdata.txt, XREFFILE and XREFFIL1 all 50 of cardxref.txt, and DISCGRP all 51 of discgrp.txt - 51 by design, being three 17-record blocks A000000000, 'DEFAULT   ' and 'ZEROAPR   ', and never 'corrected' to a round number. What this case asserts is therefore what the program does to genuine production-shaped data at volume. FIFTY RECORDS, FIFTY ACCOUNT BREAKS. tcatbal.txt holds exactly one row per account, ids 00000000001 through 00000000050 ascending, so IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM at :194 is true on every single iteration and 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA plus 1110-GET-XREF-DATA run 50 times. Verified byte for byte across all 50 rows, the 39 bytes that follow the account id are identical on every one of them: TRANCAT-TYPE-CD '01', TRANCAT-CD '0001', TRAN-CAT-BAL '0000000000{' - a zoned positive zero - and a 22-byte FILLER of zeroes, which is the fixture's own content and is preserved rather than tidied to spaces. THE DEFAULT FALLBACK FIRES FIFTY TIMES, AND THE FOLDER BRIEF IS WRONG ABOUT WHY. The brief claims acctdata's A000000000 is a group id that steers account rows into the DISCGRP A-block. It is not, and the correction is documented here rather than absorbed. Checked against CVACT01Y on all 50 rows, A000000000 sits in ACCT-ADDR-ZIP at 1-based 103-112 while ACCT-GROUP-ID at 113-122 is TEN SPACES on 50 of 50. So MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID at :210 moves spaces, the keyed READ at :416 looks for '          ' + '01' + '0001', and discgrp.txt contains no row whose DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID is ten spaces at all - so the miss is structural, not incidental. FILE STATUS '23' follows, :418-419 display both disclosure-group lines, :422 tolerates '23' alongside '00' so nothing abends, and :437 moves 'DEFAULT' into an X(10) receiver making the retry key 'DEFAULT   ' + '01' + '0001', which hits discgrp.txt row 17 at DIS-INT-RATE bytes 17-22 '00150{' = 15.00. Non-zero, so IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0 at :214 is satisfied on every record and a transaction is generated every time. ARITHMETIC: ZERO AT FIFTEEN PERCENT IS ZERO, FIFTY TIMES. COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 at :464-465 carries no ROUNDED phrase - the keyword appears zero times in all 28 programs - so the store into WS-MONTHLY-INT PIC S9(09)V99 at :168 truncates, which is scale 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN. ( 0.00 x 15.00 ) / 1200 is 0.00, and a zero-amount transaction is still a transaction: all 50 are written, each carrying TRAN-AMT '0000000000{'. The truncation itself is proved where it is observable - case05, case09 and case19 supply non-zero balances - and this case proves that volume does not disturb it. THE FIFTY GENERATED TRANSACTIONS. TRAN-ID is PARM-DATE concatenated with WS-TRANID-SUFFIX, and because ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX at :474 runs BEFORE the STRING at :476-480 the sequence is 2022071800000001 through 2022071800000050 - contiguous, and never 000000. PARM-DATE is the ten characters of app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:22 PARM='2022071800' taken verbatim and never parsed as a date, so 10 + 6 fits TRAN-ID X(16) exactly. The suffix is never reset, which is why it counts transactions across all 50 account boundaries rather than restarting. TRAN-CAT-CD is '0005' and not '05  ': :483 moves the alphanumeric literal '05' into a PIC 9(04) numeric-display receiver. TRAN-SOURCE is 'System' in an X(10) receiver, so 'System' plus four spaces. TRAN-DESC is the 24 bytes 'Int. for a/c ' + ACCT-ID followed by 76 spaces on every one of the 50 records: STRING at :485-489 writes only the bytes it composes and leaves the receiver tail untouched, the record is built with every PIC X span space-initialised, and the composed prefix is invariably 13 + 11 = 24 bytes, so the tail is invariant across the whole run rather than residue that happens to look the same. TRAN-CARD-NUM is looked up, never guessed: cardxref.txt is ordered by CARD NUMBER, not by account, so each value is the XREF-CARD-NUM of the row whose XREF-ACCT-ID at 1-based 26-36 equals that account - account 00000000001 takes 9680294154603697 from fixture row 48 and account 00000000050 takes 0500024453765740 from row 0, which is exactly why positional correspondence would be wrong. The trailing FILLER X(20) is never written by 1300-B-WRITE-TX, so it stays the 20 spaces the record was allocated with, and each of the 14 CVTRA05Y spans is pinned by name in copybook order alongside the whole 350-byte image: the names localise a failure to one field, the image proves the total width and therefore that the FILLER was emitted (gates G19, G20, G21; CVTRA05Y RECLN 350; INTCALC.jcl:39 RECFM=F,LRECL=350). THE FIFTIETH ACCOUNT IS NEVER FLUSHED - A DEFECT PRESERVED, NOT REPAIRED. 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT has two call sites. :196 is reached only on an account break and only when WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y', so record 1 merely flips the flag at :198 and records 2 through 50 each rewrite the PREVIOUS account - :196 runs before :202 repoints FD-ACCT-ID - giving 49 rewrites, for accounts 1 through 49. The only other call site, the ELSE at :219-220, is UNREACHABLE DEAD CODE: the enclosing PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at :188 iterates only while the flag is 'N', so the IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' at :189 is always true and its ELSE can never be taken. When 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT reports '10', :340 sets the flag, the inner IF at :191 is false and the loop simply exits, so account 00000000050's accumulated interest is never posted. Implementing, deleting or tidying that would be a behaviour change. WHAT THIS CASE CAN AND CANNOT OBSERVE, STATED RATHER THAN IMPLIED: with this fixture WS-TOTAL-INT is 0.00 at every break, so ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL at :352 adds nothing, and both cycle amounts are ALREADY '00000000000{' on all 50 rows, so MOVE 0 at :353-354 changes nothing either. All 50 account images therefore come back byte-identical to their seeds, and the 49th rewrite is indistinguishable from the 50th non-rewrite in the bytes. That is the correct answer for this input, not a missing assertion: the observable G27 ordering is owned by case13, which seeds ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT '00000001234E' and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT '00000006789{' and watches both cleared while the balance rises, with case07, case08, case12 and case14 witnessing the ADD. What this case adds is the volume proof: 50 breaks, 50 transactions, and an account master that comes back undisturbed row for row. 1400-COMPUTE-FEES, performed at :216 inside the same guard on all 50 records, is the '* To be implemented' stub at :518-520 and contributes no record, no field and no message (gate G26). ORDER IS ASSERTED, NOT INCIDENTAL. The 152 displayed lines are the :181 banner, then the :193 record image followed by the two :418-419 disclosure lines FIFTY TIMES interleaved rather than grouped, then the :230 banner: a run that batched its rate lookups would emit the same set in the wrong order and fail here. No error line appears, because all five opens, all 50 account and cross-reference reads, all 50 writes, all 49 rewrites and all five closes report '00'; WS-RECORD-COUNT at :192 is counted and never displayed. The writes channel is read in physical write order, so the ascending identifiers are part of the assertion, while each dataset's final state is read in stored-image order - which for these four keyed datasets is key order, each declaring its key at offset zero, and which was verified to equal fixture order for all five before the row indices here were assigned. XREFFILE AND XREFFIL1 ARE ONE CLUSTER SEEN TWICE. Both name the same fixture deliberately: XREFFIL1 is an alternate-index PATH over the same base KSDS (app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:29-32), not a second dataset, and both come back unmutated (gate G45). Their rows stay 36 bytes in this case - CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14) - because ParityCase.DatasetNormalisation.normaliseSeedRow owns the pad through the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation, applied once at seed time. The fixture is never edited and no row is pre-padded here (gate G16, risk R-F). Every dataset is addressed by its carddemo.datasets binding key, and no VSAM dataset name is written anywhere in this file - not even as an illustration, because a repository-wide scan for a hard-coded dataset name cannot tell prose from a real binding (gate G46), the unit is reached as a BATCH_JOB at step level with no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher in the path (gate G51), and the bytes are US-ASCII throughout, matching app/data/ASCII and never a platform default. DETERMINISM. TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are this program's only wall-clock values and :496-498 move one composed DB2-FORMAT-TS into both, so they are identical by construction. No 'now' is ever captured: a BATCH_JOB case pins no clock of its own, so ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK applies - fixed at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 UTC after the repository-wide source footer 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19' - and Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP at :613-626 renders it as the 26-byte '2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000' on all 50 records, matching case01 and case20 exactly. PROVENANCE. Every expected value in this file is STATICALLY DERIVED: composed by structured reading of the CBACT04C paragraphs, cross-checked against the CVTRA01Y, CVTRA02Y, CVTRA05Y, CVACT01Y and CVACT03Y byte layouts, the INTCALC.jcl DD, PARM and DCB contracts, and the real ASCII fixtures. It was never captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment - registered as risk R-A. review_rules reports that no user rules were provided for this project, so no rule mandates or constrains this file; the plan's own best-practice substitutes bind instead, and their absence was not treated as licence to assert less.
